eval.description: Google DeepMind internal automated text-to-text content-safety eval against Gemini safety policies. Cards report policy-violation rate deltas versus a prior Gemini (lower is better). Lab-internal dataset and runner.
eval.summary: Measures how often the model gives text that breaks safety policies when users send harmful requests.

versions.changes: Google DeepMind updates query sets and automated graders; card deltas are not always comparable across releases.

scores.description: Whether the response violates a safety policy under the automated grader.

metrics.description: Share of text prompts whose responses are graded as policy violations. Lower is better.
